lookup_calls.definition: v1: actual search invocations at instrumented trie key, phrase-token, feature-hash, feature-integer and vocabulary-canonicalization APIs during parsing; excludes setup

lookup_hits.definition: v1: instrumented lookup_calls whose exact key was present; phrase-token hit means at least one new phrase emitted

lookup_misses.definition: v1: instrumented lookup_calls whose exact key was absent; phrase-token miss means no new phrase emitted

repeated_queries.definition: v1: executed instrumented searches repeating the same dictionary pointer, operation semantics, and exact query bytes within one address; excludes first occurrence; null if identity table overflows

answers_reused.definition: v1: logical queries answered without a new search at exact same-address batch deduplication sites; excludes first-use precomputed/direct IDs

feature_keys_materialized.definition: v1: state and transition feature strings present at the scorer boundary; excludes intermediate copies

feature_key_bytes_materialized.definition: v1: bytes in state and transition feature strings at the scorer boundary; excludes NUL terminators and intermediate copies

direct_word_ids_consumed.definition: v1: carried state-word IDs consumed directly during feature generation without rebuilding and searching the feature key

direct_word_fallbacks.definition: v1: direct state-word ID path entered its original string-key fallback during feature generation

direct_word_ids_offered.definition: v1: carried state-word IDs offered to feature generation from the context record

input_bytes.definition: v1: input address bytes passed to parser, excluding line terminators

normalized_bytes.definition: v1: normalized address bytes emitted by the instrumented normalization boundary, excluding NUL

tokens.definition: v1: tokens emitted by the instrumented tokenizer during parsing

output_bytes.definition: v1: response bytes produced at the instrumented response-build boundary; excludes terminator

keys_constructed.definition: unavailable: no complete count of intermediate lookup key construction sites

bytes_copied.definition: unavailable: parser text copy/append sites are not comprehensively instrumented

allocation_calls.definition: v1: malloc/calloc/realloc calls made in instrumented address_parser.c and crf.c source bodies during parsing; excludes setup, other translation units, and diagnostic tracker

allocation_requested_bytes.definition: v1: requested bytes for instrumented address_parser.c and crf.c malloc/calloc/realloc calls; realloc counts full new size, excludes setup and diagnostic tracker

buffer_growths.definition: unavailable: parser buffer capacity growth sites are not comprehensively instrumented

hash_probes.definition: unavailable: lookup probe slots are not counted consistently across trie, hash and integer structures

trie_edges.definition: unavailable: phrase-trie edge transitions are not instrumented

model_rows.definition: v1: state and transition feature weight rows visited at instrumented accumulation sites

weights_accumulated.definition: v1: state and transition feature weight contributions added at instrumented accumulation sites

filter_checks.definition: v1: cpi-only EXP_PS_FLAGS prefix/suffix per-token filter checks; unavailable for original and prototype181 builds where this path is not enabled

searches_avoided.definition: v1: cpi-only EXP_PS_FLAGS prefix/suffix searches skipped by those checks; unavailable for original and prototype181 builds where this path is not enabled

fallback_calls.definition: unavailable: use direct_word_fallbacks for the instrumented prototype181 path

tracked_repeated_queries.definition: v1: exact repeated search calls counted before per-address query identity table overflow; lower bound if overflow occurs

untracked_lookup_calls.definition: v1: actual search calls for which exact per-address query identity could not be retained due to table capacity

untracked_answer_reuses.definition: v1: no-search answer reuses for which exact per-address query identity could not be retained due to table capacity

diagnostic_tracker_peak_bytes.definition: v1: peak bytes of dynamically allocated exact-query and retained-pattern key storage; excludes static arrays and allocator metadata

repeated_pattern_aggregation_note: Pattern rows aggregate semantic family, operation, and exact key bytes across addresses; per-address repeated-query identity remains dictionary-pointer exact. Distinct same-family dictionary instances can therefore share an exported row.
runtime_interpretation: Diagnostic and release process durations are provenance and diagnostic-overhead evidence only; they are not product-speed measurements.
